product.title: Sunset Tour, Moab, Off-road and Scenic Backcountry

description.text: Explore the scenic backcountry near Moab, without the hassle of renting a 4WD, self-driving, or navigating, on this small-group sunset tour from Moab. Hop into a Jeep Rubicon, and let your drive you around the rugged backcountry terrain, look for dinosaur tracks, and admire the sunset over the desert landscape, with a local guide to provide enriching commentary.Explore areas of the backcountry you can't reach in a regular car Ideal for adventurous travelers, photographers, and families Stay fueled and hydrated with provided snacks and bottled water Enjoy a more personal experience and pace in a small group Stops include Hell's Revenge. Transportation, safety gear, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on the red rock landscape. Ideal for travelers basing in Moab who want a guided Utah adventure without self-driving backcountry roads or river put-ins.
